name: Wes Anderson Wool-Felt Diorama
zh: 韦斯·安德森毛毡光影剧场
summary: Planimetric, dead-centre symmetric stop-motion diorama in Merino wool felt, after The Grand Budapest Hotel and Fantastic Mr. Fox: curly fibre field with melange flecks on a glacier-mint striped wall (#84B1AE) under a 2900K top light, appliqué patches with 1.5–2.5 px fuzzy edge hairs and quilted plush domes, running-stitch borders, four-hole cross-stitched buttons and brushed-brass key tags, in Mendl's pink (#F2BFC0), mustard (#E3A33B), cranberry (#A43237) and concierge plum (#5B3461). Natively supports 1920×1080 (16:9 three-storey hotel + funicular stage) and 1080×1440 (3:4 centred dollhouse cross-section).
